'''2007 US East Nationals Day 1 James Booker DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[James Booker]] at [[2007 US East Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Booker, James
* '''Deck name:''' N00b Beater
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
